coverageBoundaries.focusProbe: Programmatic HTMLElement.focus verifies native inert; the separate recorded keyboard paths use real Playwright Tab, Shift+Tab and Escape input.
coverageBoundaries.clipboard: A synthetic paste Event with injected DataTransfer verifies application selection and raw-CR handling; it does not exercise the OS clipboard.
coverageBoundaries.unknownWrite: Playwright lets route.fetch complete a real MySQL commit and then substitutes HTTP 503 for the page; this is API response fault injection, followed by read-only SQL verification.
coverageBoundaries.beforeUnload: Firefox and WebKit evidence covers a cancelable browser event, not a native user-agent prompt. Existing Chromium unsaved-changes acceptance separately observes the native prompt.
coverageBoundaries.safari: The result covers Playwright WebKit 26.5, not an installed Safari release.
coverageBoundaries.narrowWidth: 320 and 390 are CSS-pixel viewport widths. The suite does not claim it changed browser UI zoom to 200%.
